maddeler.e:
نتنرفز (form IIq)
# نَتَنَرْفَزُ (natanarfazu) /na.ta.nar.fa.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَرْفَزَ (tanarfaza)
# نَتَنَرْفَزَ (natanarfaza) /na.ta.nar.fa.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَرْفَزَ (tanarfaza)
# نَتَنَرْفَزْ (natanarfaz) /na.ta.nar.faz/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَرْفَزَ (tanarfaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
